title: ani-gui — Backend Status
history_empty: No entries yet. Watch something and it will show up here.
metadata_cache_description: Wipes the SQLite cache that holds Kitsu search results, anime details, episode lists, and title→id mappings. Your watch history and your settings are not affected.
open_search_link_hint: — find anime by title, browse posters and metadata.
cache_reclaim_description: Stored entries this version never reads were removed when the app started:
cache_reclaim_old: Kept under an earlier version's format: {count}
section_retired_sweep: Cleaned up after a removed provider
retired_sweep_superseded: These history entries were replaced by newer ones for the same show, so they were removed:
retired_sweep_renumbered: These history entries were kept; only how their episode is stored changed:
retired_sweep_stored: Stored entries nothing reads any more, removed: {count}
legacy_sweep_description: These files are no longer used, so they were deleted:
banner_framing_description: Shows a small control on the home page and on each show's page for choosing how the banner is framed and which image it uses first. The choice is kept on this computer and stays in effect after the controls are hidden again.
hero_walk_description: The trending shows the home banner's last pick read, in order, and what it did with each. Use it to check the airing preference. Open Home first, then come back here.
hero_walk_failed: Could not read the last pick.
hero_walk_none: Home has not picked its banner shows yet in this session.
hero_walk_origin_cache: a saved copy of the flags file
hero_walk_signed_note: On means a signed file turned it on. An unsigned file can only turn it off.
hero_walk_summary: Read {read} of {entries} trending shows with the airing preference {preference}. The shows not read are in the trending row, a repeated show once.
hero_walk_taken_fill: no art, fills an empty slot
hero_walk_skipped_not_airing: not airing, an airing show took its place
hero_walk_skipped_no_art: no art, and enough shows had art
row_style_description: Shows a small control on the home page for choosing how its rows present their actions: beside each row's title, or at the end of the row's header, with a band that marks out the row while the pointer is over it or focus is inside it. The choice is kept on this computer and stays in effect after the control is hidden again.
start_look_description: What the player shows while an episode starts loading. Both looks are being tried out, and one will stay.
